stem: A crop difference appears after an irrigation event. Which statement best preserves the evidence boundary?
choices: Record irrigation as the confirmed cause
Record the timing as context while keeping causation unresolved unless additional evidence supports it
Remove the timing because context creates bias
Change the irrigation program before documenting the pattern
rationale: Record the timing as context while keeping causation unresolved unless additional evidence supports it. This response preserves the Course 002 evidence, identity, role-boundary or documentation principle being assessed.
